profile.headline: Driving Scalable IAM Solutions in Lifecycle Automation | Audit Readiness | Secure Dev Practices | Requirements Gathering | Collaborating with Stakeholders | Application Support & Training
profile.summary:
I specialize in designing secure, scalable Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions that enable enterprises to operate efficiently, securely, and with confidence. With a strong foundation in software development, identity governance, and system integrations, I bring a holistic approach to solving complex technical challenges across global organizations.
In my work, I’ve built automated identity lifecycle workflows—from onboarding to offboarding—leveraging platforms like SailPoint IdentityIQ, Active Directory, SCIM, and RESTful APIs. These solutions not only optimize provisioning but also improve compliance, security posture, and audit readiness across the board.

My toolkit includes:
✅ Programming in Java, BeanShell, C#
✅ Database design and querying in SQL Server and MySQL
✅ Web technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery
✅ DevOps workflows using Git, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD pipelines

In every project, I aim to balance engineering precision with real-world business needs. I actively promote collaboration between development, infrastructure, and business stakeholders—making sure every solution is aligned with both operational requirements and long-term goals. I also prioritize documentation, maintainability, and security best practices to ensure smooth knowledge transfer and scalable codebases.

What sets me apart is my ability to speak both the language of code and the language of impact—translating technical strategies into value-driven solutions that serve users, teams, and the enterprise at large.

Currently seeking opportunities where I can contribute to next-generation IAM architecture, automation initiatives, and secure software delivery pipelines in forward-thinking organizations.
Let’s connect if you’re looking for someone who’s not just fluent in identity access—but also in bridging technology with purpose.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Sailpoint Developer/Consultant)
positions.description:
In this role, I focused on enhancing system reliability and audit-readiness by refining provisioning workflows and boosting IdentityIQ performance. I engineered secure, scalable integrations across a variety of connectors—including Active Directory, CIAM, SCIM, PingID, and RESTful APIs—to support seamless identity governance.
Key wins:
✅ Improved client environments by developing clean, efficient code that prioritized scalability, security, and compliance.
✅ Executed SailPoint IIQ upgrades and conducted thorough regression testing to ensure secure, disruption-free deployments.
✅ Led project delivery using industry best practices, overseeing change management through Azure DevOps, code reviews, and automation tools.
✅ Strengthened team capabilities by providing hands-on technical support and peer mentorship across complex troubleshooting scenarios.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
During this tenure, I led the design and execution of the initial IAM implementtion with SailPoint IdentityIQ to fully automate identity lifecycle processes—integrating systems like Active Directory, SAP SuccessFactors, Cherwell, and SOD policies-to elevate provisioning efficiency and strengthen enterprise security. I also developed a robust ASP.NET application that centralized metadata and system dependencies, equipping analysts, DBAs, and developers with faster, more actionable insights across Global IT.

Key wins:
✅ Spearheaded a global SAP ERP and SailPoint IIQ rollout, supporting 14,000+ users and driving digital transformation across multiple regions.
✅ Enhanced identity and access management (IAM) by initiating change management practices aligned with SailPoint standards and best practices.
✅ Streamlined code consistency and accelerated IIQ deployments through automation, improving scalability and security posture across all environments.

volunteerExperiences.description: Work with resident felines improving their social skills, increasing trust and comfort around strangers, and helping to resolve any bad habits to increase their chances of successful adoption.

I volunteer at the Inmate Dog Alliance Project of Idaho (IDAPI) at the Humane Society of Boise.  I believe in "Win-Win" solutions whenever possible, and in my view this program is a perfect example of just that!

Stressed and "difficult to adopt out" dogs are matched with inmates who have earned the right to participate in the program through good behavior.  They live together, 24-7, and are put through daily training and guidance from a professional dog trainer.  The IDAPI program produces a very happy, well adjusted dog, as well as excellent "life lessons" for the inmates on giving back and serving others.  Many weeks later, when they both pass their training goals, the dogs are then adopted back out to the community through the Idaho Humane Society.  The inmates walk away knowing the joy of giving back to a worthy animal and compassionate pet owner, and if possible they do it all over again with their next dog!
